title: Closure under a finite gate operation
statement: Let $m,n$ be nonnegative integers, let $G$ be an AND or OR gate, let $v_i:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a family of functions indexed by $i\in\text{Fin}(m)$, and let $S\subseteq\text{Fin}(m)$. Suppose each $v_i$ with $i\in S$ has width at most $w$ in the normal form associated with $G$. The function obtained by applying $G$ pointwise to the functions indexed by $S$ also has width at most $w$ in that normal form.
hypotheses_covered: Choice of an AND or OR gate
Family of Boolean functions indexed by Fin(m)
Each selected function has associated normal-form width at most w
